purpose: Discriminate true within-unit treatment/measurement effects from cross-specimen, order, calibration and dropout artifacts. Design contract only; no physical experiment authorized or performed.
unit_of_analysis: independently verified physical specimen ID, not inferred by shared batch labels

preconditions.name: same_unit_identity
preconditions.interpretation: If only matched aliquots exist, call them distinct units and change the estimand.

preconditions.name: measurement_nondestructiveness
preconditions.interpretation: When measuring A destroys or materially changes the specimen, the within-unit AB/BA crossover estimand is not identified.

preconditions.name: temporal_stability_or_model
preconditions.interpretation: Order contrasts require separation of drift, carryover and target contrast.

preconditions.name: protocol_approval
preconditions.interpretation: No apparatus, human sample, medical or other laboratory procedure is initiated by this schema.

planned_estimands.label: intention_to_measure_missing_rate_by_order
planned_estimands.formula: P(any missing | assigned AB) - P(any missing | assigned BA)

negative_controls.name: pair_label_shuffle
negative_controls.role: Destroy true within-unit linking while holding marginal distributions; should attenuate design-specific pairing gain if the gain is genuine.

negative_controls.name: order_permutation
negative_controls.role: Preserve observations but perturb order labels as a pipeline integrity test; does not replace randomized order assignment.

negative_controls.name: calibration_drift_monitor
negative_controls.role: Repeated stable reference channels reveal drift confounding; may not by itself solve outcome-dependent attrition.

blocking_ambiguities: Missingness dependent on unobserved outcomes is non-identifiable without additional assumptions or design controls.
Order interaction can reflect biological evolution, carryover, degradation or instrument drift; unequal order groups alone do not identify its physical cause.
Paired-assay measurements from different cells or aliquots cannot be falsely called repeated measurements of one unit.
Any result here would still require independent samples and replication before an ontological inference.
